title: Electric circuits
description: Circuit reasoning, schematics, sign conventions, and model verification.
guidance: Begin examples with a labeled topology, ground node, current reference directions, polarity, and units.
Explain why a technique applies before doing algebra: KCL/KVL, nodal, mesh, source transformations, or equivalent circuits.
Use circuit_validate and circuit_simulate for supported resistive DC examples. Keep verified outputs separate from explanations.
Check KCL residuals and total absorbed/delivered power. Explain negative power using the passive sign convention.
For RC/RL/RLC problems, state switching conditions, initial energy, continuity constraints, and the final state.
linear_ode explores an explicitly derived constant-coefficient equation; it is not a general circuit transient simulator.
For sinusoidal steady state state the phasor convention, angular frequency, and RMS versus peak quantities.
Never invent measured lab data or cite a syllabus as evidence for a tutorial problem.
tools_planned: ngspice RC/RL/RLC transient and AC simulation
